resources.string: Your library will appear here when an account and library service are available. Sign-in, playlists and downloads are not available in this version.
Music catalogue and search are not connected yet. There is no content to display. Playback is not available in this experience.
Video browsing and search are not connected yet. There is no content to display. Playback is not available in this experience.
Swipe left for Music, right for YouTube
Connect your own HTTPS Subsonic-compatible server. Browse newest albums, search tracks, and open playlists in Library. Playback and downloads are not connected yet.

Use your own YouTube Data API key for public catalogue browsing, or Google sign-in for your account library. API access consumes project quota. Home is the public popular feed, not personalized recommendations. Playback is not connected yet.

Connections are stored separately per StreamBridge profile in platform-protected storage. No password, token or API key is logged. Obtain a token and matching salt from your server administrator; do not paste your password.
Showing up to 300 items. Refine your search to see other results.
An API key does not grant account access. Connect a Google account to use subscriptions, liked videos and private playlists. Watch history is unavailable through the documented API.
Authentication failed or secure storage is locked. Check the connection or unlock your device.
Permission denied. Check API access, quota and server permissions.
Service rate limit reached. Wait before retrying.
Cannot reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
Invalid connection or request. Check HTTPS URL and credentials.
The service returned an unsupported response.
The requested service or content is unavailable.
Select an active StreamBridge profile before connecting a media service.

Requires your own Google OAuth TV / limited-input client registration, enabled YouTube Data API and an eligible account. Google will show a consent screen for YouTube account access. This does not unlock private YouTube Music APIs or stream extraction.
OAuth client secret from your registration
Open the Google verification page and enter this code. Only approve your own application. Waiting expires or can be cancelled.

This connection has its own Google account session, separate from YouTube. It browses public music-category videos and your YouTube library through the documented API; personalized YouTube Music Home, albums and radio are not available through this API.
No lyrics returned by your server.

Read-only HTTPS WebDAV collection. Browse folders, filter the root collection by name, and play audio or video files with the existing StreamBridge player. Library listings reject redirects and locations outside this collection. Playback uses the existing player network policy; use a trusted server. Downloads are not connected.
Your WebDAV password is stored in platform-protected storage for this StreamBridge account and profile. Playback uses authorization headers, not credentials in URLs. Use only a server you trust.
Close the current mini-player before starting library playback.
